title: Sample: May possible household saving — pero sulit lang under the right condition
summary: Demo ng Practical card: dapat may yen impact, effort, catch at clear DO / WAIT / SKIP recommendation.

title: Sample: New scam pattern — ano ang warning signs?
summary: Demo safety alert. Live records should use police, Consumer Affairs Agency or other strong Japanese sources whenever possible.
why_it_matters: Practical alerts should prevent actual loss, not just repeat generic 'be careful online' advice.

content.who_is_affected: Residents receiving suspicious payment or account messages.
content.risk_if_ignored: Potential financial loss or account compromise.
content.action: AVOID — huwag gamitin ang link sa unsolicited message; access the official service manually.
content.potential_benefit: High downside avoided for very little effort.
content.downside: None beyond taking an extra minute to verify.
